Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Principal Data Engineer, Data Technology

Department Background: CTO Infrastructure

The Opportunity

We are looking for an exceptional Principal Engineer to serve as the technical anchor for the Data Technology domain, covering platforms and capabilities including Enterprise Data Assets (EDA), Reference Data, Big Data & Movement, and Data Decisioning engineering.

This role will drive technical strategy, architecture, and engineering excellence across distributed data platforms that are foundational to data democratization, AI enablement, customer insight, and regulatory compliance. The Principal Engineer will provide hands-on leadership in modern data and digital engineering practices, hybrid cloud enablement, event-driven architecture, and platform scalability to ensure enterprise-ready and future-fit data services.

This role is suited for a senior technologist with deep experience in data platform engineering and the ability to influence product and delivery teams across a large, global, matrixed organization

What You’ll Do

  • Define and evolve the reference engineering standards for core data provisioning platforms, ensuring alignment to the bank’s Group Data Strategy and Data Future State Architecture.
  • Provide deep technical standards and approach leadership across key platforms:
    • Enterprise Data Assets (EDA) and APIs for standardized data provisioning
    • Reference Data Services for golden source alignment and hierarchy management
    • Big Data and Movement technologies for ingestion, streaming, and transformation at scale
    • Decisioning Infrastructure including real-time feature stores and orchestration
    • Lead peer reviews and ensure platform consistency, reusability, and compliance with enterprise standards.
    • Guide development teams in implementing data pipelines, APIs, metadata-driven controls, and automated testing frameworks.
    • Champion DevSecOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code across engineering teams.
    • Drive the control transition to using agentic AI coding assistants.
    • Lead the technology Developer Experience, enabling the whole of technology to discover, understand and onboard themselves to our services.
    • Drive best practices in observability, performance engineering, cost optimization, and scalability in hybrid cloud environments.
    • Mentor senior engineers and influence technical delivery across multiple squads and geographies.
    • Collaborate with Architecture, Cybersecurity, CDO, and business product owners to align engineering outcomes to strategic objectives.
    • Represent the domain in cross-platform technology councils and architecture forums.

    What You Will Need To Succeed In The Role

    • 15+ years of hands-on experience in data platform engineering, architecture, or software development, preferably in a global financial institution or scaled enterprise.
    • Expertise in building large-scale data pipelines, APIs, and event-driven systems using modern frameworks and technologies (e.g., Spring, Kafka, Spark, etc).
    • Strong architectural understanding of data mesh, data lakehouse, and real-time, customer-facing operational & analytics platforms.
    • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and GCP), containerisation, and IaC tools.
    • Deep familiarity with development tooling and automation covering modeling, observability, resilience, and , and governance patterns.
    • Strong track record of building reusable platform services that accelerate delivery for data consumers and AI/ML initiatives.
    • Experience with enterprise reference data management and integration is highly desirable.
    • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage and guide both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Cultivates Innovation: Creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful
    • Strategic Mindset: Seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies
    • Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
    • Builds Effective Teams: Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals
    • Drives Vision & Purpose: Painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others to action
    • Being Resilient: Rebounding from setbacks and adversity when facing difficult situations
    • Manages ambiguity and ensures accountability: Operating effectively, even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear; holds self and others accountable to meet commitments
    • Persuasion & Conviction: Using compelling arguments to gain the support and commitment of others; stepping up to address difficult issues and saying what needs to be said

    You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

    HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

    Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of DAI Delivery Lead.

 Business: Digital Platforms IWPB Technology

Job ID ： 57094

The Role

International Wealth and Personal Banking (IWPB) continues to invest in exceptional products services and experiences for customers. As DAI Delivery Lead you’ll be accountable for end-to-end delivery outcomes across the Digital Authentication & Identity (DA&I) portfolio ensuring stable secure and high-quality engineering and support services. Reporting to the Head of Digital Platforms you’ll align delivery priorities with IWPB and Digital Platforms strategies across major DA&I systems including DSP and DIVA. This role focuses on predictable execution strong governance and continuous improvement across change delivery and run-the-bank work. Success means delivery outcomes that meet agreed scope timelines quality and cost while protecting platform resilience in a security-critical domain. You’ll partner closely with platform and engineering leaders and engage senior stakeholders including IWPB CIO-level and China Technology Leadership to progress decisions and manage escalations.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery execution across DA&I programmes and run-the-bank change against agreed scope timelines quality and cost
  • Establish delivery governance across plans milestones dependencies RAID resourcing and financials to support clear decisions and early escalation
  • Embed disciplined agile at scale ways of working plus DevSecOps practices and measurable quality gates across delivery teams
  • Prioritise and sequence delivery demand with Platform Leads and portfolio leadership balancing change throughput with operational stability
  • Improve delivery performance using metrics such as predictability lead time incident trends defect leakage environment stability and automation coverage
  • Recommend trade-off options on scope time cost and risk to protect customer outcomes and platform resilience
  • Coordinate end-to-end readiness across cyber security architecture data infrastructure-cloud and service management including release and change governance
  • Develop delivery capability across teams including talent succession and inclusive ways of working across locations

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bring substantial technology delivery leadership experience across software development in complex regulated environments
  • Demonstrate proven delivery of customer-focused outcomes across large-scale change and operational support
  • Apply deep understanding of authentication and authorisation engineering ideally within internet-mobile banking or large digital channels
  • Show strong working knowledge of resilience scalability performance and observability across application data and infrastructure
  • Use established cyber security practices and cloud concepts with a secure-by-design approach to delivery
  • Demonstrate practical experience delivering at scale using enterprise agile approaches and DevSecOps tools and processes
  • Influence senior stakeholders across a broad technology organisation and manage cross-team dependencies to clear outcomes
  • Hold SAFe-Agile ITIL cloud or security certifications such as CISSP or CCSP or bring equivalent demonstrable experience

/LP/WX

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review and Retrospective.
  • Coach teams on Agile/Scrum principles and continuously improve team maturity and delivery effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business processes, pain points and strategic priorities.
  • Conduct analysis and documentation of business requirements, user journeys and system/process impacts.
  • Translate business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications.
  • Partner with Product Owner and delivery teams to prioritize backlog items based on business value and dependencies.
  • Identify delivery risks, impediments and blockers; drive timely resolution and escalation where required.
  • Support UAT planning, test scenario definition and quality assurance alignment with business expectations.
  • Track and report sprint and release metrics (velocity, burn-down, cycle time, delivery predictability, quality indicators).
  • Build and maintain strong communication channels across business and technical teams to ensure transparency and alignment.
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization and propose practical, data-driven improvements.
  • Support change management, user enablement and post-implementation adoption activities.
  • Own end-to-end project management activities including project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring/control and closure.
  • Define and manage project scope, timeline, milestones, resource plan and budget to ensure on-time and within-budget delivery.
  • Establish and maintain RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), governance cadence and escalation framework.
  • Drive cross-team/vendor coordination and dependency management across technology, operations and business units.
  • Prepare management reporting and steering committee updates on project health, delivery progress and decision points.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational standards, SDLC controls and audit/regulatory requirements where applicable.
  • Manage release readiness and implementation planning, including cutover, communication and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Support benefits tracking and realization against approved business case/objectives.

Requirements

  • University degree or above.
  • Minimum 10+ years of relevant working experience in technology/digital delivery, including proven experience in Scrum Master, Business Analyst, Project Manager, or hybrid delivery roles.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery framework, SDLC and project management methodologies (Agile/Waterfall/Hybrid).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Experience in requirement elicitation, process mapping, story writing and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Hands-on experience in project planning, dependency mapping, financial/budget tracking and resource management.
  • Experience with Agile and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Office, Power BI, MS Project).
  • High customer-centric mindset with commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to influence diverse stakeholders and drive outcomes under pressure.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to balance strategic and tactical priorities.
  • Experience in governance reporting, risk/issue management, and senior stakeholder/SteerCo communication.
  • Relevant certification(s) such as CSM/PSM, PMI-ACP, CBAP/CCBA, PMP/PRINCE2 would be an advantage.

  • Practical experience with generative AI or agentic systems, such as LLM integration, RAG, tool use, orchestration, evaluation and guardrails. Experience with LangChain or a comparable framework is preferred.
  • Experience applying AI-enabled development practices to achieve measurable improvements in engineering productivity, quality or automation.

Job Description

The main purpose of this role is to lead IP(Infrastructure Platforms) in China LIB, and to support and maintain the technical infrastructure ensuring that:

  • the service is delivered as agreed to all Lines of Business (LoB)
  • all projects are managed according to plan
  • the operational risk environment is managed and reported appropriately
  • costs are managed
  • that there is an active program to train and develop staff for career development.

The role is a key influence across all other technology functions, ensuring that engineering and support standards are maintained. This involves communicating at every level in the organization, reporting into the location technology operating committee and other business forums as appropriate.

Responsibilities

  • Location:
  • Act as a communication point to the LOBs, Senior Management Leadership groups and represent IP to the location technology function at the LOC (Location Operating Committee).
  • Represent the technology function to all vendor and outside service relationships, speaking at functions representing JPMC when invited.
  • Perform a senior Technology advisory role to location and business leaders within the location.
  • Provide escalation point for technology in location.
  • Capture demand in location by engaging with the local business and communicate this to relevant IP areas.
  • Support legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements for LoBs.
  • Service Delivery and Projects:
  • Understand the service delivery profile of the location for all tower groups in IP and the Business Aligned Infrastructure groups (BAI). Ensure the service that is provided matches the requirements of all LOBs (Lines of Business) through regular reporting reviews and improvement programs.
  • Facilitate the infrastructure management group to ensure that communication lines are
  • maintained with all stakeholders, and that regular meeting structures, agreed reporting and governance are all in place and is being maintained.
  • Manage and facilitate the process of incident management of the location whenever service issues are discovered, reacting to all alerts as appropriate; ensure that the right level of support is available, on-call, 24x7.
  • Establish strong linkage with regional / global teams to leverage common processes, function and resources to manage to global service delivery targets.
  • Risk Management:
  • Understand and manage the risk profile of the location, providing updates and reporting as required. Report to the location operating committee and regional risk management when required.
  • Monitor and engage all risk forums for the location, ensuring adherence of the control environment and that all local towers follow respective and resultant action plans, ensure all location Managers sign off and approve their respective controls, creating evidence as necessary.
  • Represent the location in scope discussions escalation of issues and draft report status of all internal and external audits, in conjunction with the regional tower and BAI leads.
  • Represent the location technology groups in discussion with regulators, ensuring that all technology is setup appropriately under the guidelines provided by those regulators for all technology groups.
  • Provide overall responsibility, oversight, direction and leadership for business continuity and disaster recovery activities within location.
  • Financial:
  • Ensure that the financial aspects of the location are managed. Conduct regular reviews with all tower Managers so that the plan is correct, that expenses are being booked correctly and that any variance is explained.
  • Ensure that asset management processes and procedures are implemented and followed at all times.
  • Ensure all staff resources are in plan, and are under contract, as appropriate. Conduct regular reviews with all tower Managers to ensure location is covered.
  • People Management:
  • Ensure that a career and staff development program is in place, such that all employees have an opportunity to grow and improve in their respective roles.
  • Ensure regular reviews are conducted, which should include objective setting and follow up, quarter, mid and end of year appraisals. IP lead to advice towers on talent in location.
  • Lead and deliver at local staff forums, present global, regional and location news and updates so that staff feel engaged in the progress of the organization.
  • Contribute to the support network within JPMC by conducting coaching and mentoring to all levels locally and remotely.
  • Deliver leadership training and development to all Managers and VP's

Qualifications / Experience

  • Fluency in written and spoken Chinese and English
  • In excess of 15 years IT experience, the majority of which should be in an infrastructure role, preferably within the financial services sector.
  • Familiar with line of products within IP a big plus, able to lead the team and work with broad IP team ensure LIB production stability.
  • A strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills, communication skills. Logical thinking, details driven and well ordered.
  • In excess of 10 years demonstrated experience at a management level, being able to articulate proven staff development and growth success
  • Experienced in working in an influential role, specific experience in senior roles with no direct reporting relationships with subordinate staff would be an advantage
  • Experience in managing vendor and supplier relationships
  • Experience in working in Asia Pacific liaising and communicating at all levels across the region
  • Strong communicator able to create and maintain people relationships

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AVP - CRM.

Principal responsibilities

CLCM and product LCM oversight

  • Support CLCM across all propositions/ channels/ products in AMH WPB with a primary focus on customer activation and relationship deepening, driving customers from perfect onboarding to grow along vintage to become engaged customers and use HSBC as main bank.

CRM demand management

  • Support CRM demand management to ensure business demand prioritisation is based on strategic intent to maximize CLCM impact
  • Socialise the performance results and share best practices with product teams for continuous optimisation

Innovation projects

  • Support the delivery of innovation projects such as GenAI PWS chatbot capability, etc.

Customer outcomes

  • Create exceptional value for customers by elevating personalised messaging to support customer needs along the wealth building journey.

Requirements

  • Excellent understanding of wealth and personal banking products on top of digital commercialisation, with strong business focus in customer propositions and segmentation
  • Possesses relevant retail banking experience at project/product owner level preferred
  • Understanding of Hong Kong retail banking market and mainland China strategic market
  • Hands on experience in managing projects of high complexity, with strong planning, organization, problem-solving skills and attentiveness to details
  • Strong commercial acumen - ability to link data to business and customer outcomes
  • Great sense of ownership; excellent relationship building and senior stakeholder management skills including an ability to operate in a complex, matrix driven environment

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Data and Analytics (AI Data Engineer).

Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID: 59158

Principal Responsibilities

  • Build and operate pipelines for structured domain data (onboarding events, customer/entity data, credit facilities/exposures, limits, risk grades, portfolio hierarchies, performance and arrears).
  • Build unstructured data pipelines for domain documents (KYC documents, corporate registries extracts, credit memos, financial statements, portfolio review materials): parsing, metadata enrichment, deduplication and retention handling.
  • Develop embedding/vectorisation pipelines and manage vector indices with refresh and deletion strategies aligned to data governance.
  • Implement data quality, observability and lineage: automated testing, SLAs, anomaly detection, monitoring and runbooks.
  • Apply privacy-by-design: PII handling, masking/tokenisation where required, access controls and audit trails.
  • Implement dataset versioning and reproducibility (snapshots, schema evolution, data contracts) to support repeatable evaluations.
  • Partner with Agent Engineers and stakeholders to define data requirements and evaluation datasets; close feedback loops from production retrieval/agent performance.
  • Support production operations and continuous improvement of data services powering AI.

Requirements

  • Delivering reliable, fresh, well-governed datasets and indices used by KYC, credit and portfolio AI solutions.
  • Improving retrieval relevance and answer grounding by strengthening metadata, chunking inputs, and data quality.
  • Reducing operational incidents through strong testing, monitoring, and disciplined change management.
  • Making AI datasets reproducible and auditable to support reviews and control expectations.

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Experience working with sensitive data domains (KYC/AML, credit risk) and implementing controlled access patterns.
  • Familiarity with vector search concepts, document ranking/reranking and retrieval metrics.
  • Experience with feature stores or MLOps-style dataset management.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

We are currently looking for an experienced Client Service Manager to join our Client Service Team.

Why this role is important to us

State Street Global Delivery, provides asset owners and managers with a wide range of support, from core custody, accounting and fund administration to complete servicing for complex alternative assets like OTC derivatives and private equity.   • Manage activities in servicing client relationships and client operations i.e. respond to escalated issues, communicate resolution to clients, monitor metrics around inquiries being resolved at point of contact, and escalate unresolved issues to senior management as needed
  • Keep senior management informed of new developments, service issues, and new business opportunities
  • Facilitate cross-functions/teams communication to resolve client issues/queries and deliver high quality services
  • Promote a collaborative cross-business and jurisdiction environment that fosters change and innovation
  • Provide Subject Matter Expertise for new business on-boarding and other projects as required
  • Drive relevant project work to improve client service
  • Lead continuous evaluation of team operations, encouraging innovative ideas to enhance efficiency, reduce risk or increase revenue

  • Effectively deliver key messages & communication to ensure relevant parties are informed of any client’s activities
  • Assist with compliance/fiduciary reviews, controls, and audits as appropriate
  • Sound risk and compliance controls with immediate resolution of non-compliant items identified
  • Adhere to State Street corporate policies and procedures including but not limited to the Standard of Conduct
  • Perform other duties as required

  • Strong leadership skills - the candidate must be very comfortable with taking on responsibility and accountability.
  • Strong communication skills - there is a significant amount of interaction with clients, senior management and other key stakeholders.

Education & Preferred Qualifications
